task_title: Directional player neutral and walk assets

plan_review.notes: Adopted 4x8 row-major atlas under 4096px instead of 8192px strip; added cross-direction coherence, opaque-bounds normalization, composed provenance, per-direction idle-frame runtime fix, a single-direction 256x390 spike before fan-out, and explicit obsolete-asset hygiene. Rejected runtime texture switching, engine-side composition, and skipping durable neutral approvals.

independent_grade.notes: The change delivers a coherent 8-direction 32-frame player atlas end to end. The core runtime fix in walkDirectionFromVelocity is a real boundary bug fix and is pinned by tests. Directional validation, manifest clips, frame-local opaque bounds, runtime wiring, and idle behavior agree across implementation and tests. Rectangular sheet support and the 32-frame limit are justified by the asset-generation and atlas requirements. Determinism, layer boundaries, and shared portability are preserved. The deterministic one-off composition tooling is maintainable and no provable defect remains.
